payload.text: CAPABILITY (commodity cross-asset leaf): celnet-commodity-vanilla::price is the Black-76 commodity/future-option pricing entry on the carry seam — a pure, side-effect-free closed form taking (OptionType, &CommodityInputs) that discounts the forward directly (no spot carry), reconciled to Haug's published Black-76 reference and an independent QuantLib-pinned oracle. It is the commodity capability's projection target through the one contract. No I/O, allocation, logging, or mutation.
